*Reconstructing the Concept of Exclusion in Private Monopolization* is scheduled for release on April 8, 2022.

<https://amzn.to/34ghxz6>

![](/blog/posts/2022-04-02-32677717/image-1.jpg)

The book brings together the research for my doctoral dissertation, on which I have worked since around 2016, and the research I did as a postdoc. In particular, about two chapters — an analysis of the debate over the goals of competition law and a comprehensive review and analysis of the concept of exclusion — were newly written for the book.

The table of contents is not yet on the publisher's website, but here it is:
